### Storeroom

Shelves, barrels, and one brass lantern with oil still in it. It lights on the
`first` strike, which never happens.

![A lantern, lit](lantern.png)

1. Lift the lantern
2. Strike the wick
3. Do not look behind you

choices.text: Take the lantern and press on
Put the lantern back on the shelf
